title: Colourful chemistry of anthocyanins: a tutorial review of applications of anthocyanins in school and university teaching
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SU00933B, Tutorial Review
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Iain A. Smellie, Isobel Everest, Iain L. J. Patterson
This tutorial review provides chemistry educators with literature coverage (to the end of 2025) of teaching activities that feature plant-derived anthocyanin extracts. Overviews and procedures for example activities have been also been provided.
